mapper.select: SELECT app.application_id, app.announcement_id, a.title AS announcement_title, app.company_user_id, u.company_name, u.business_no, app.project_name, app.total_budget, app.request_grant, app.self_funding, app.summary, app.plan_file_name, app.status, c.code_name AS status_name, app.submitted_at, app.created_at, e.total_score FROM application app INNER JOIN announcement a ON app.announcement_id = a.announcement_id INNER JOIN users u ON app.company_user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON app.status = c.code_id AND c.group_id = 'APP_STATUS' LEFT JOIN evaluation e ON app.application_id = e.application_id WHERE app.application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET project_name = #{projectName}, total_budget = #{totalBudget}, request_grant = #{requestGrant}, self_funding = #{selfFunding}, summary = #{summary}, plan_file_name = #{planFileName} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE status = 'SELECTED'
